item.title: Honey Badger Wars: Wild Africa's Deadliest Animals FIght
item.description:
Watch the complete Honey Badger Wars: one honey badger against Africa's deadliest animals, in one continuous story.
This full episode follows honey badgers through their toughest confrontations with rock pythons, baboon troops, leopards, and hyena clans. We separate internet myths from documented predator behavior and focus on the biology that keeps these animals alive against odds that would kill most creatures their size.
You'll see how it works: loose, thick skin that lets a honey badger twist around and bite even when it's gripped, and partial resistance to some snake venoms. Resistant, not immune. The cost of each fight is shown on screen. This wildlife documentary draws on published research and field accounts to explain how a roughly 10 kg mustelid holds its ground against much larger predators.
⏱ Chapters: 0:00 The Mongoose's Risky Den Defense 0:53 Why the Cobra Targets This Den 1:41 The Moment of Confrontation 2:48 The Science Behind the Survival
This is a compilation of the Honey Badger Wars series, told in order.
